description: Permanently removes a user from an organization in Zendesk by deleting the organization membership. This action is irreversible — the membership cannot be recovered once deleted. Use this action when you need to remove a user's association with an organization. This operation requires admin permissions.

organization_membership_id.description: The ID of the organization membership to delete
organization_membership_id.human_parameter_description: The numeric ID of the Zendesk organization membership you want to delete. This removes a user from an organization. You can find this ID from listing organization memberships.
organization_membership_id.title: Organization Membership Id

name: delete_organization_membership

success.description: Indicates whether the membership deletion was successful
success.title: Success
